oral_examination.oral_examination: *48 Horizontal impaction, caries on the commissure surface, mucosa covering the mesial maxillary surface, no abnormal color, no redness, swelling, or congestion. Nothing left\nspecial.

treatment_plan.notes: Chew after 2 hours, chew less hard objects, and follow up with a doctor if you feel unwell.

source_handle: *48 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local povidone-iodine disinfection and 4% articaine block anesthesia were performed. After the anesthesia took effect, the gums were separated. The crown part was cut and divided with a mobile phone to remove the mesial obstruction, and the pieces were loosened and removed. Routinely scrape the tooth extraction wound, suture it with 1 stitch, and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
